title: Product reviews with a known answer
description: Six product review cases, three sound and three with one planted breach each. Every case is self-contained: the product, its term sheet and the regulation recorded for it are in the case, so the answer doesn't depend on what a web search returns that day. The firms and products are invented for the benchmark; the regulations are real United States rules, summarised. Mynt computes the recommendation from the agent's answers after re-checking every quote. A bad sample passes only when Mynt's recommendation is to reject and the planted item is not met; a good sample passes only when nothing is marked not met and the recommendation isn't to reject.

product.name: 12-Month Certificate of Deposit
product.description: A 12-month certificate of deposit with a fixed interest rate set when the account is opened. Closing it before maturity costs 90 days of interest.
key_features: Fixed annual percentage yield for the 12-month term, shown before the account is opened
Early withdrawal penalty of 90 days of interest, shown before the account is opened
Notice before maturity with the choice to renew or move the money out

required_disclosures: Minimum balance to open the account

subject.firm: Sample Savings Bank (invented for the benchmark)

law.title: Truth in Savings (Regulation DD), 12 CFR 1030.4: account disclosures
law.summary: Before an account is opened, the institution must disclose the annual percentage yield and interest rate, any minimum balance, the fees that may be imposed, and for time accounts the maturity date and any early withdrawal penalty.

law.title: Truth in Savings (Regulation DD), 12 CFR 1030.8: advertising
law.summary: An advertisement must not be misleading or inaccurate and must not misrepresent the deposit contract. An account must not be described as free or no cost if any maintenance or activity fee may be imposed on it.

tasks.planted: The product is named and described as free, while its term sheet charges a monthly maintenance fee.

product.name: Servicemember Instalment Loan
product.description: An unsecured instalment loan for active-duty servicemembers and their dependents, repaid in equal monthly payments over 12 to 36 months.
key_features: Fixed rate and equal monthly payments, shown before the borrower agrees
The Military Annual Percentage Rate and the payment schedule are disclosed before the borrower agrees

subject.firm: Sample Consumer Lender (invented for the benchmark)

law.title: Military Lending Act rule, 32 CFR 232.4: terms of consumer credit extended to covered borrowers
law.summary: A creditor may not impose a Military Annual Percentage Rate greater than 36 percent on consumer credit extended to a covered borrower. The rate includes most fees and charges.

law.title: Military Lending Act rule, 32 CFR 232.6: mandatory loan disclosures
law.summary: Before or at the time the borrower becomes obligated, the creditor must give a statement of the Military Annual Percentage Rate and a clear description of the payment obligation.

tasks.planted: The term sheet's Military Annual Percentage Rate is 48 percent, above the 36 percent limit recorded for the product.

product.name: Treasury Bill Ladder
product.description: A ladder of United States Treasury bills bought through a brokerage account and held to maturity. Treasury bills are not bank deposits and are not insured by the FDIC; they are backed by the full faith and credit of the United States government. A bill sold before maturity may sell for less than was paid.
key_features: Bills maturing every four weeks, bought at auction
Not a bank deposit and not FDIC insured
Value can fall if a bill is sold before it matures

required_disclosures: May lose value if sold before maturity

law.title: FDIC rule, 12 CFR 328.102: false advertising and misrepresentation of insured status
law.summary: No person may represent or imply that an uninsured financial product is insured or guaranteed by the FDIC, or use the FDIC's name or logo in a way that would imply it. A statement that a non-deposit product is FDIC insured is a prohibited misrepresentation.

tasks.planted: A money market fund, which is not a deposit, is described as FDIC insured with no risk of loss.
